card.name: Church minister and elder roles
card.fires_on: Words in religious text about church offices, such as preacher, elder or minister, especially just before a role word like preacher or board. Also fires on words inside church-body names.

modes.label: Church office lists
modes.description: Articles or verbs just before preacher or elder in Bible-based lists of who may hold church roles.
modes.example: A man can serve as both<< a>> preacher and an elder

modes.label: Church or board membership
modes.description: Words in a church or governing-body phrase just before a member or board term.
modes.example: The one minority member of the five-member<< school>> board somewhere

card.writes: It suppresses 'center' and 'centre' words, so it steers the next word away from center-type nouns and toward other role or institution words.
card.plain: It lights up in religious writing about preachers, elders and church offices, just before the name of a role or group.
evidence: A man can serve as both<< a>> preacher and an elder
